How Many Card Shops Are in Edmonton?

Edmonton has 19 sports card shops in our directory, from single-owner storefronts to multi-sport hobby shops that also carry Pokémon and other trading card games. See every one of them, with addresses, hours, and a map, on the full Edmonton shop directory.

How We Pick the Best Card Shops in Edmonton

Of Edmonton's 19 shops, 19 carry a public Google rating, and 17 of those have at least 20 reviews behind that rating — the bar a shop has to clear before we'll call it "best" or "top-rated" on this page. A perfect rating from a couple of reviews is too easy to fluke, so a shop with hundreds of honest reviews shouldn't get outranked by one with a single 5-star review from a relative. Shops below that bar are still in our directory, just not crowned here.

Which Edmonton Shops Carry Hockey Cards?

Capital City Sports Cards, Gamesland Canada, and Outpost Sports Cards and Games tag hockey specifically in our directory data for Edmonton. That's a gap in what we've verified rather than a sign other shops don't carry hockey — general sports card shops often stock hockey without listing every sport online, so it's worth asking any Edmonton shop directly if hockey is what you're after.

Before You Visit an Edmonton Card Shop

Hours at small, independently run shops can drift from whatever's posted online, so a quick call or message ahead saves a wasted trip. If you're hoping to sell or trade, ask what a shop is looking for before you show up — some buy collections outright, others prefer straight trades. Our card grading 101 guide is worth a read first if you're weighing whether a card is worth grading before you sell or trade it.

If you'd rather browse in person, Alberta's card show calendar is another way to see a lot of dealers in one place — check upcoming Alberta card shows for dates near Edmonton.
